text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Claiming victory in the Satsuki Sho is— 
It's Agnes Tachyon after all—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Haha...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see, I see...! Racing truly is 
endlessly fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, be that as it may. The real deal 
starts from here.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Dammit! Dammiiit...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: She really is strong...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aaah!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—Next time! The Japanese Derby, without 
fail...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I will definitely surpass them...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With renewed determination, the Satsuki 
Sho came to a close—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few weeks later, the incident occurred.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I, Agnes Tachyon, am going on an 
indefinite hiatus from racing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon made what was essentially an 
announcement of her retirement.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"After stating as a preface that 'the leg 
trouble was merely an indirect cause'—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Stating she would observe the Umamusume 
who reach 'Truth,' she departed the press 
conference room."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Not Tachyon-chan, no...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This retirement announcement sent massive 
shockwaves through every walk of life."

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
"No, honestly, I was surprised... or 
rather, it was quite a shock!"

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
Her talent has been the talk of the town 
since her debut, and I was so, sooo 
looking forward to her Triple Crown run!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: My god has disappeared~! Waaah~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Still, she's still enrolled at the 
academy, right? That means she hasn't been 
deregistered, so maybe she'll just pop 
back in out of the blue...

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
The Agnes Tachyon Paka Puchi figures are 
limited to two per customer!

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"B-But I really wanted to see Tachyon run 
in the Nippon Derby...!!"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Voices
text_block_list.text:
"I'm in total shock" "No way" "The Classic 
campaign just lost its main star"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Voices
text_block_list.text:
"‘If only it were Agnes Tachyon, she would 
have definitely shown us the most 
magnificent view!’"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...They really are amazing...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'm in shock about them being gone, too. 
After all, we're classmates, friends, and 
rivals..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now, the people who aren't 
are just as shocked."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
To have so much expected of me after just 
four races...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...If it were me, that would surely have 
been impossible."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I should have known.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Tachyon-chan is amazing. She's far and 
away the most talented in our generation.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Like this, even if I had won... I 
wouldn't have truly won——)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Aah, jeez!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to be timid. After all, 
it's not like Tachyon-chan wanted to 
retire either.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I just have to keep moving 
forward...! Doing everything that is 
within my power—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Stand at the top of our generation at the 
Japan Derby, beat everyone, and then—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And there— I have to surpass 
Tachyon-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If I can't even manage that much, I'll 
never be able to become the main star 
going forward!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(The 'Japanese Derby'... The one who'll 
stand in my way is surely—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Alright...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, but I'm in a foul mood right 
now. If you wanna run, how about we do it 
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Counting on you for the Nippon Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I will win, no matter what. Against 
Pokke-chan... against everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
S-So yeah! That's how it is, see you 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...What's with her, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
“Counting on you for the Nippon Derby,” 
huh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Shaking off the vivid brilliance left 
behind by Agnes Tachyon, I'll definitely 
reach the center stage in our next race, 
the Japanese Derby!"
